summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 8,571,429 ADSs (each representing 10,000 ordinary shares) with Series A-1 and A-2 warrants at a combined price of $0.70 per ADS and accompanying warrants. The placement was made to an accredited investor under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. H.C. Wainwright served as exclusive placement agent, receiving a 7.5% cash fee and warrants. The filing includes registration rights and customary terms but does not constitute a special situation; it is a capital-raising transaction with no change of control, restructuring, or acquisition.
